name: – Céline Imart – Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on providing macro-financial assistance to the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan
part_text:
The European Parliament backs a plan to lend Jordan up to €500 million to help steady its economy. Jordan is hosting about 1.3 million refugees and faces high debt, high unemployment and pressure from conflicts nearby. The money would come in three payments, each released only if Jordan carries out agreed reforms, such as better public finance management and anti-corruption work. Parliament also wants the European Union to keep it informed and to deepen its partnership with Jordan.

- The European Union would lend Jordan up to €500 million in three instalments tied to reforms.
- It affects Jordan's government and people, including the refugees it hosts.
- Next, talks with Jordan set the reform conditions; Parliament must be kept informed.
